documentTitle: NDMA India — Managing Crowds at Events and Venues of Mass Gathering
authority: National Disaster Management Authority, Government of India

sections.sectionTitle: Venue Layout, Usable Gathering Space & Structural Exclusions
sections.summary: Calculate gathering space strictly after deducting buildings, stages, utility compounds, restricted areas, and reserved movement corridors so holding estimates reflect actual standing ground.
sections.verbatimQuote: Venue capacity planning must distinguish gross site footprint from net usable gathering space by excluding permanent structures, stages, technical compounds, and dedicated circulation corridors.

sections.sectionTitle: Separating Entry and Exit Pedestrian Flows
sections.summary: Maintain unidirectional pedestrian circulation where high-volume ingress meets egress, avoiding shared narrow bidirectional corridors and crossing queues.
sections.verbatimQuote: Incoming and outgoing pedestrian streams should be separated through dedicated one-way corridors and segregated gate funnels to prevent head-on contra-flow compression and queue cross-cutting.

sections.sectionTitle: Queue Management, Holding Zones & Barricading Discipline
sections.summary: Design dedicated holding zones ahead of security screening and entry gates with properly anchored barricades that do not spill into lateral walkways or obstruct exit aprons.
sections.verbatimQuote: Dedicated holding buffers and zig-zag queue lanes must be sized for peak arrival surges so waiting crowds do not spill across active circulation routes or block adjacent exit discharges.

sections.sectionTitle: Preventing Stall, Hawker & Utility Pinch Points
sections.summary: Keep food stalls, water distribution points, and temporary structures clear of circulation corridors, ambulance lanes, and high-voltage stage rear areas.
sections.verbatimQuote: Commercial stalls, water kiosks, and temporary utility fixtures shall not encroach upon pedestrian walkways, exit clearance aprons, or emergency vehicle lanes.

sections.sectionTitle: Dedicated Emergency Access Corridors & Ambulance Routes
sections.summary: Preserve continuous, unobstructed emergency vehicle lanes connecting perimeter roads to medical posts and stage zones throughout the full event schedule.
sections.verbatimQuote: Unobstructed emergency access lanes for ambulances and fire tenders must remain physically segregated from general spectator zones and free of temporary stalls, barricades, or parked equipment.

sections.sectionTitle: Medical Posts, Control Rooms & Authority Coordination
sections.summary: Locate medical aid posts and event control rooms on walkable routes with direct ambulance access, and align operational command with statutory police, fire, and medical authorities.
sections.verbatimQuote: Medical posts and joint command centres must connect directly to both walkable crowd zones and emergency vehicle corridors, with statutory authorities retaining final operational command.
